title: Three-checkpoint restricted population matrix
method: Local Showdown full matches, side-swapped paired evaluation, generated teams from each checkpoint's saved preview selector, two outcomes per team-pair cluster. Each off-diagonal cell was bootstrap-resampled by team-seed cluster. Diagonal 50% entries are symmetry assumptions, not self-play measurements.

restricted_game_solution.interpretation: Among these three policies, the Round430 row point-estimate scores at least 50% against every column policy; the corresponding empirical restricted-game solution is pure Round430. This estimate inherits sampling uncertainty and does not cover unmeasured policies or hidden-team responses.
restricted_game_solution.promotion_decision: No new checkpoint is promoted. Round430 remains the measured incumbent.

limitations: This is a three-checkpoint restricted game, not an equilibrium certificate for VGC.
Only one of the three off-diagonal matchups is a fresh 256-cluster run; the other cells reuse separate recent Round465 screens with 128 or 256 clusters.
The opponent population contains only related PPO versions and does not include newly trained responses.
The Round465-vs-Round430 screen had one incomplete game; the published interval uses completed records and clusters.
Round430-vs-Round464's lower 95% endpoint is only 0.10 percentage points above 50%; this ranking is fragile.
